title: Insights into the identification of antimicrobial peptides: A multidisciplinary observation.
abstract: Antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) exemplify the principle of "Life finds a way" by adapting to diverse environmental niches. These peptides exhibit remarkable specificity, targeting pathogens unique to their respective habitats. Understanding the ecological context of AMPs not only clarifies how these peptides selectively target pathogens while remaining nontoxic to hosts, but also underscores the potential of computational approaches in AMP discovery and design. By integrating biological omics data with computational modeling, researchers can develop novel AMPs tailored to combat specific microbial threats, paving the way for innovative therapeutic solutions in an ever-changing microbial landscape.
